notes.title: Patch note 3.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Thank you so much for all your support [/b][/h1]

Hello everyone,

The Unknown region early access version 3 has been out for more than 3 weeks now, and I have Received a Good response from you!

Thank you so much for playing and streaming Unknown region _ Early access version 3

Since the release, I have been working on some changes and bug fixes. Here is a list of what this Patch includes:


[h1][b]Implementation of vendor management 
[/b][/h1]

The new trade system was implemented on the map with new locations. Once you find the traders you'll be able to buy sell items.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/e7b95fd99ee8227d4b8157309f900d30e6b56672.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/35ec309aa90db52aafba5e1f5a7894e681c75db8.png[/img]


[h1][b]NEW AI BASE OWNERS [/b][/h1]

The new AI base owners are now available in new locations on the map. Now you can raid their bases and loot them, but this is what you can expect if you try it out 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/4511c67131d43b89c393a87f8f21d72af1adc94d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/1bf18fc13247a4d23693e68f289d2043dd6fa36e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]

[b]-[/b] Day-night cycle speed degraded 
[b]-[/b] Reduced the darkness of the night
[b]- [/b]Dead AI body despawn time increased
[b]- [/b]Improved models and textures of the landscape and building blocks
[b]-[/b] Added 20 scrap metals as starting items.
[b]-[/b] Added 3 melee AI hunters to the AI group.
[b]-[/b] 4 new locations - AI bases and vendor locations.
[b]-[/b] New enemies- 3 new melee hunters
[b]-[/b] Extra slots in the backpack, clothing items, and workbench.
[b]-[/b] implemented user interface sounds.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]

- Issue with consumables audio 
- Axe and pickaxe do not delete on quick slot after destroying 
- crosshair visibility on the opened inventory
- Save system not loading items after a number of saves
- Weapon workbench and punji sticks not saving 
- Weapon swapping not working correctly
- Swapped weapons not firing

notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
1. Implementation of a new map. The new map has greater performance than the previous one.
   It has many abandoned houses, barn areas to explore.
   new AI randomly spawning in main areas of the map. These are the most dangerous AI characters, so 
   be careful: Gang shooters, bears, wolves, fox, wild boar, wild tribes, snakes, spiders, zombies, and 
   creatures.
   
2. Addition a new day-night cycle with a dynamic weather system. 
3. New abandoned houses, barn fields, and lakes.
4. Addition new items to the loot spawn list.
5. Added new zombie and creature AI characters and removal of some creatures, for example, elephants, rhino, polar bear, zebra, and grenade shooters. 
6. Added random ammo option to the guns, now guns spawn with random ammo.
7. Beautiful new scenery throughout the game. 
8. Fixed weapon not attaching to FP hands when a new client connects.
9. Fixed stamina not reducing on start.
10.Fixed issue with resource collision.
11.Removed vehicles from multiplayer, vehicles available only for singleplayer, multiplayer vehicles has 
    few bugs so once I fix I will add the vehicles for multiplayer.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/48751b8d54b28b6587fe8f659cc3b2103c8aa26b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/1a4d40b0c1a6e76da62e32d8619c678551ea72b6.png[/img]

1. Added map option, allows players to know their location.  Players can add destination marker to easily navigate. 
2. Introduction of a new vehicle system, allows players to flip cars if they happen to get stuck. Just press the Z key and this will prevent any frustrating moments.
3. Addition of new vehicles.
4. All vehicles now have the ability to kill animals. But it depends on the vehicle speeds, lower speed won't make any damage to the AI.
5. Reduce overpowered AI, for example now raccoon, snakes will only damage 5. 
6. Fixed crafting list empty when interacting with the actor.
7. Added random ammo to the guns, now guns will spawn with random ammo.
8. Added multiple items to the spawners.
9. Changed the main menu UI and loading screen.
10. Added more landscape details, lakes, drinking zones, and smooth landscapes to let players drive anywhere on the map easily.
11. Fix the vehicle audio issue was not able to decrease the audio. 
12. Removed some AI and replace some of them with Zombies.
13. Fixed melee impact sound not working.
14. Decreased player health, hunger, and thirst timers, without having any food or water, can survive  25 minutes.
